GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2024-01-26T08:54:26Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Port is not opened on keepers only using composable protocols
Description: 
**Description**
When using the composable protocols configuration for serving prometheus metrics with tls, clickhouse server with only keeper configuration does not open specified port.

**How to reproduce**
* Clickhouse version 23.3.19.32

To reproduce the issue two nodes should be deployed, one as "data" node and the other one as a keeper.
Example config:
```xml
<remote_servers>
<example>
  <shard>
    <internal_replication>true</internal_replication>
    <replica>
      <host>data-node.example.com</host>
      <port>9000</port>
      <secure>true</secure>
    </replica>
  </shard>
</example>
</remote_servers>

<keeper_server>
  <server_id>1</server_id>
  <tcp_port_secure>2181</tcp_port_secure>
  <raft_configuration>
      <secure>true</secure>

      <server>
          <id>1</id>
          <hostname>keeper-node.example.com</hostname>
          <port>2182</port>
      </server>
  </raft_configuration>
</keeper_server>


```

In both configs I do specify prometheus metrics endpoint using composable protocols following explanation given in this issue #49003:
```xml
<prometheus>
  <endpoint>/metrics</endpoint>
  <metrics>true</metrics>
  <events>true</events>
  <asynchronous_metrics>true</asynchronous_metrics>
</prometheus>

<protocols>
  <prometheus_protocol>
      <type>prometheus</type>
      <description>prometheus protocol</description>
  </prometheus_protocol>

  <prometheus_secure>
      <type>tls</type>
      <impl>prometheus_protocol</impl>
      <port>9999</port>
      <description>prometheus over tls</description>
  </prometheus_secure>
</protocols>

```


**Expected behavior**
Port 9999 is opened on both "data" node and keeper node and is under TLS.

**Actual behavior**
Port 9999 is only opened on the "data" and not the keeper node.

**Logs**
There were no messages in log with a mention of this prometheus configuration, checked it on trace level.
